parameters.query:
SELECT cs.id, cs.campaign_id, cs.account, cs.action_type, cs.target, cs.reason,
       cs.hypothesis, cs.predicted_metric, cs.predicted_direction, cs.threshold,
       cs.window_days, cs.utm_campaign, cs.tracked_url, cs.outreach_draft,
       cs.step_number, cs.adaptive_action, cs.adaptive_reason, c.run_id
FROM cadence_steps cs
JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = cs.campaign_id
WHERE cs.status = 'pending' AND cs.scheduled_for <= now()
ORDER BY cs.scheduled_for ASC
LIMIT 50;
